result.title: Region-Guided Food-Package Evidence Extraction and Abstention-Aware Draft R3337 Screening with Selective VLM Review
result.summary: Applying South Africa's draft R3337 warning criteria to food-package photographs requires nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. This study presents a region-guided evidence extraction and abstention-aware screening workflow for draft R3337. A three-class detector localises nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions, after which PaddleOCR and structured extraction recover nutrient values, ingredient evidence and product-form information. Recovered evidence is aggregated and assessed using deterministic draft R3337 rules. When evidence is incomplete, uncertain or conflicting, the workflow abstains through Review or Insufficient evidence rather than forcing an automatic outcome. For qualifying unresolved cases, a selective vision-language model (VLM) review stage using Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct reassesses unresolved evidence. Accepted evidence is merged and the same deterministic rules are reapplied. The workflow was applied to 442 products represented by 3,929 images. Evaluation used a manual validation set of 65 products. Before selective VLM review, 31 of 60 decidable products received automatic outcomes and 30 were correct, giving 51.7% coverage and 96.8% accuracy among automatic outcomes (selective accuracy). Selective VLM review resolved eight additional products, increasing coverage to 65.0%. Of 39 automatic outcomes, 38 were correct, giving 97.4% selective accuracy. The single false warning was retained from the rules-only workflow, while no unsafe warning omissions occurred after selective review. Evidence-level evaluation nevertheless identified incorrect VLM-recovered nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. These findings show that selective VLM review can recover unresolved evidence, while deterministic screening and explicit abstention remain necessary for reliable image-based draft R3337 screening.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了一套针对南非 R3337 草案的食品包装图像筛查流程：先用三分类检测器定位营养标签、配料表与产品标识区域，再用 PaddleOCR 与结构化抽取回收证据，按确定性规则判定，并在证据不全或冲突时选择弃权（Review / Insufficient evidence），仅对未解决案例调用 Qwen3-VL 进行选择性复核后合并证据重判。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据不足即弃权、仅对未解决案例触发 VLM 复核」的路由设计，可能为 LOOK/STOP 的触发条件与证据可靠性筛选提供借鉴线索；但论文聚焦法规筛查应用，未涉及内部 latent 状态，证据层面的 VLM 抽取错误也可供核查「模型是否真正使用了视觉证据」。
